meta.name: onecli-gateway
meta.description: OneCLI Gateway: transparent HTTPS proxy that injects stored credentials into outbound calls. You MUST use this skill when the user asks you to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub repos, create issues, check Stripe payments, or interact with ANY external service or API. Do NOT use browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools. Make HTTP requests directly; the gateway injects credentials automatically.

copy.tagline: 自动为外部API请求注入凭证，无需手动认证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要调用多个外部API并处理认证
copy.tagline_en: Automatically inject credentials into external API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently call multiple external APIs and handle authentication

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会直接向外部 API 发 HTTP 请求,由 OneCLI 网关在代理层自动注入已存凭证,你不必提供密钥。它能读邮件、查日历、访问 GitHub、查 Stripe 付款等。
howto.when: 当你要求它读邮件、查日历或访问 GitHub 等外部服务与 API 时接管。它会直接发 HTTP 请求,而不是用浏览器扩展或 OAuth 工具。

say.text: 读一下我 Gmail 收件箱最新的 5 封邮件
say.note: Claude 直接调 Gmail API,凭证由网关注入

say.text: 列出我 GitHub 上前 10 个仓库
say.note: 走 api.github.com,不需要你给 token

say.text: 查一下 Stripe 最近 5 笔付款
say.note: 拿不到凭证时它会给出连接链接

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude sends HTTP requests straight to external APIs; the OneCLI gateway injects stored credentials at the proxy, so it never handles them. It can read email, check calendars, reach GitHub, check Stripe payments and more.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask it to read email, check calendar or reach GitHub and other external APIs. It calls the API directly, not via browser extensions or OAuth tools.

say_en.text: Read the 5 latest emails in my Gmail inbox
say_en.note: Calls the Gmail API; gateway injects credentials
